messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager P1 — canary latency spike for model rholm-bert-quant v2 in us-west1. 95th latency crossed 1.8s (SLO 1.2s). Error-rate ~5% for generate endpoint. Alert URL: https://redwood.in/alerts/ALRT-3142

alice (oncall): taking this. oncall rotation: alice -> i'm investigating now. tagging ml-infra and sre.

ben (ml-infra): looking. can you share the canary pool id?

alice (oncall): pool: rw-canary-usw1-3, nodes: gpux-8q. Canary traffic is ~2% of prod.

cara (sre): impact? any customer-facing failures or just latency?

devon (product): quick check — a single customer reported generation timeouts on autocomplete around 12:03 UTC, likely routed to canary. we have support ticket #TI-8824.

alice (oncall): initial check: no node crashes. CPU/GPU utilization normal. latency spike correlates with increased Redis KV-cache misses on rholm-bert-quant v2. Sharing logs.

logbot: Attached logs for request window 2026-03-14T12:00:00Z - 2026-03-14T12:12:00Z (filter: model=rholm-bert-quant, variant=v2, pool=rw-canary-usw1-3)

ben (ml-infra): pasting tail of error stream:```
[12:02:57Z] ERROR infer: kv_cache_miss=127 failures=3 retry_init=true
[12:03:00Z] WARN runtime: falling back to unoptimized kernel for attention
[12:03:02Z] ERROR runtime: kernel_launch_failed: code=E-137
[12:03:03Z] INFO infer: request_id=abc123 latency=2100ms status=error
```

alice (oncall): thanks. hypothesis 1: quantization+new kernel path in v2 causing intermittent kernel failures leading to slow fallback paths. Hypothesis 2: new batching change increased token window, causing cache starvation.

ben (ml-infra): adding canary-diff info: v1 -> v2 diffs I see in rollout config:
- quant_profile: q4_0 -> q4_1 (more aggressive)
- pref_kernel: attn_fast -> attn_opt2
- kv_cache_enabled: true -> false (intentional)
- batch_policy: dynamic -> pooled_batch (max_batch=32)

cara (sre): kv_cache flip is suspicious. that would increase memory pressure on GPU and cause more kernel variants. Also kernel_launch_failed aligns with attn_opt2.

devon (product): why was kv_cache toggled off for v2? that seems like a big perf change for canary.

ben (ml-infra): it was an experiment to reduce cold-start token memory; rollout note: "disable kv cache for quantized run to avoid alignment issues". Apparently not fully validated for pooled_batch.

alice (oncall): tracking hypotheses in-thread: [H1] quant kernel attn_opt2 unstable on gpux-8q -> evidence: kernel_launch_failed logs. [H2] kv_cache disable -> higher misses -> longer runtime. [H3] pooled_batch increases concurrency -> racing kernel selection.

cara (sre): timeline so far:
- 12:00:00Z: canary rollout to v2 started (auto-canary rollout)
- 12:01:10Z: first elevated 95th latency metric
- 12:02:50Z: kernel_launch_failed begins in logs
- 12:03:05Z: incident-bot P1 page fired
- 12:05:30Z: 5% error-rate sustained

ben (ml-infra): quick diff of model binaries: v2 built with attn-opt2 kernels from cudakernel v2.4. Those kernels had limited QA on gpux-8q. rolling back kernel preference should be low-risk.

alice (oncall): decision: mitigate first -> reduce canary to v1 for safety. Rollback plan: pin canary pool rw-canary-usw1-3 to rholm-bert-quant v1. Runbook command: 
```bash
# pin pool to previous model
redwoodctl rollout cancel --pool rw-canary-usw1-3 --to-version rholm-bert-quant@v1
redwoodctl exec --pool rw-canary-usw1-3 --restart infer-ss-
```
I'll execute if no objections in 2m.

devon (product): +1 from product, prioritize customer request.

ben (ml-infra): +1, also will prepare a safer kernel profile revert and a follow-up canary with kv_cache=true and pooled_batch disabled.

ops-bot: Executing rollback command requested by alice (oncall).
ops-bot: Rollback initiated: action_id=RB-2107.

ops-bot: Rollback complete for pool rw-canary-usw1-3. New active version: rholm-bert-quant@v1. Health checks passing.

alice (oncall): monitoring post-rollback metrics. so far 95th back down to 1.0s within 90s. Error-rate trending to 0.1%.

cara (sre): marking incident as mitigated for now. capturing notes for RCA.

ben (ml-infra): I'll collect full kernel traces and run a repro on gpux-8q lab. Will also open an urgent test matrix for attn_opt2 on quantized builds.

devon (product): I'll update support ticket TI-8824: customers routed off canary, rollback completed, monitoring.

alice (oncall): follow-ups (owners):
- ben: kernel QA + repro (ETA 48h)
- ben: prepare new canary spec (kv_cache=true, pooled_batch off) (ETA 24h)
- cara: add a canary gating check for kernel_launch_failed metric before auto-rollout (ETA 72h)
- devon: customer comms (ETA 1h)
- alice: write short incident timeline and draft RCA (ETA 24h)

alice (oncall): temporary note: consider adding pin enforcement to prevent kv_cache flips during canary without explicit safety flag.

ben (ml-infra): will also add preflight checks to validate kernel availability on target instance types (gpux-8q).

cara (sre): closing this thread as mitigated, will reopen if error-rate rises. :white_check_mark:

alice (oncall): final: thanks team. good coordination. reopening will go through the same thread for traceability.

incident-bot: Incident P1 (ALRT-3142) marked mitigated by alice (oncall) at 2026-03-14T12:13:...
